text:
Eli: Quick FYI — noticed the new 'interviewer checklist' checkbox in Orbit ATS isn't being persisted for some users. People click it but the candidate timeline shows no flag.
Nora: That's bad, we rely on that to verify shadowing and calibration for new interviewers. Which cohorts affected?
Eli: Mostly invitees who used the mobile link during onsite scheduling (iOS webview). Desktop seems fine.
Sam: Possible client-side cookie/storage issue in the webview. I'll check error rates and the frontend feature flag rollout.
Priya: In the meantime we should prevent inadvertent hires. Can we make the checkbox required only for first-time interviewers? If persistence is flaky, require a quick shadow confirmation instead.
Eli: Agreed. Short-term workaround: forcing a server-side validation on submit that checks interviewer profile `first_time_panel=true` and returns an error if checkbox not present. Sam, can you add that guard?
Sam: Yup. I'll add a blocking validation and return a friendly message instructing them to use desktop if needed. Pushing patch to staging now.
Nora: Also let's record a 5-min screencap showing how to complete the checklist and where the flag appears in candidate timeline. Pin to #hiring-resources.
Priya: I'll draft a 10-point quick checklist and schedule 15-min shadow sessions for anyone listed as first-time in the next two weeks. Will also update onboarding to remove the mobile link until fixed.
hiring-bot: New training event "Interviewer checklist + shadow session (15m)" created for tomorrow 3:00pm. RSVP required for first-time interviewers. :calendar:
Eli: Thanks everyone. Sam — please add a note on OPS ticket about mobile webview bug and include client logs. We'll run a short audit to see how many submissions missed the flag in last 7 days.
Sam: On it — logging output in OPS-5212. ETA for prod guard: ~2hrs after QA.
Priya: Once guard is live, hiring managers will be notified to re-check any recent panels where the flag is blank. I'll prepare a template message.
Eli: Great. Filing a short post-action item list: add server guard, remove mobile link in onboarding, publish screencap, run 7-day audit, schedule shadow sessions. Owner list in OPS-5212.
